verses.original: δέ Λέγω ἐφ’ ὅσον χρόνον ὁ κληρονόμος ἐστιν νήπιός διαφέρει οὐδὲν δούλου ὤν κύριος πάντων
verses.transliteration: de Legō eph’ hoson chronon ho klēronomos estin nēpios diapherei ouden doulou ōn kyrios pantōn
verses.literal: [What] I am saying [is that] as long as . . . . . . the heir is a child he is no different . . . from a slave [although] he is the owner of everything

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐστὶν ὑπὸ ἐπιτρόπους καὶ οἰκονόμους ἄχρι τῆς προθεσμίας τοῦ πατρός
verses.transliteration: alla estin hypo epitropous kai oikonomous achri tēs prothesmias tou patros
verses.literal: - He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by [his] father

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὅτε ἦμεν νήπιοι ἡμεῖς ἤμεθα δεδουλωμένοι ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hote ēmen nēpioi hēmeis ēmetha dedoulōmenoi hypo ta stoicheia tou kosmou
verses.literal: So also when we were children we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world

verses.original: δὲ Ὅτε τὸ τοῦ χρόνου πλήρωμα ἦλθεν ὁ Θεὸς ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοῦ τὸν Υἱὸν γενόμενον ἐκ γυναικός γενόμενον ὑπὸ νόμον
verses.transliteration: de Hote to tou chronou plērōma ēlthen ho Theos exapesteilen autou ton Huion genomenon ek gynaikos genomenon hypo nomon
verses.literal: But when the - time {had} fully come - God sent His - Son born of a woman born under [the] law

verses.original: ἵνα ἐξαγοράσῃ τοὺς ὑπὸ νόμον ἵνα ἀπολάβωμεν τὴν υἱοθεσίαν
verses.transliteration: hina exagorasē tous hypo nomon hina apolabōmen tēn huiothesian
verses.literal: - to redeem those under [the] law that we might receive [our] adoption as sons

verses.original: δέ Ὅτι ἐστε υἱοί ὁ Θεὸς ἐξαπέστειλεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ αὐτοῦ Υἱοῦ εἰς ἡμῶν τὰς καρδίας κρᾶζον Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: de Hoti este huioi ho Theos exapesteilen to Pneuma tou autou Huiou eis hēmōn tas kardias krazon Abba ho Patēr
verses.literal: And because you are sons - God sent the Spirit of His Son into our - hearts crying out Abba - Father

verses.original: ὥστε εἶ οὐκέτι δοῦλος ἀλλὰ υἱός δὲ εἰ υἱός καὶ κληρονόμος διὰ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōste ei ouketi doulos alla huios de ei huios kai klēronomos dia Theou
verses.literal: So you are no longer a slave but a son and since [you are] a son [you are] also an heir through God

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ μὲν τότε οὐκ εἰδότες Θεὸν ἐδουλεύσατε τοῖς φύσει οὖσιν μὴ θεοῖς
verses.transliteration: Alla men tote ouk eidotes Theon edouleusate tois physei ousin mē theois
verses.literal: - - Formerly vvv when you did not know God you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods

verses.original: δὲ νῦν γνόντες Θεόν μᾶλλον δὲ γνωσθέντες ὑπὸ Θεοῦ πῶς ἐπιστρέφετε πάλιν ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ καὶ πτωχὰ στοιχεῖα θέλετε δουλεύειν οἷς ἄνωθεν πάλιν
verses.transliteration: de nyn gnontes Theon mallon de gnōsthentes hypo Theou pōs epistrephete palin epi ta asthenē kai ptōcha stoicheia thelete douleuein hois anōthen palin
verses.literal: But now that you know God or rather vvv are known by God how [is it that] you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles Do you wish to be enslaved by [them] all over again

verses.original: παρατηρεῖσθε ἡμέρας καὶ μῆνας καὶ καιροὺς καὶ ἐνιαυτούς
verses.transliteration: paratēreisthe hēmeras kai mēnas kai kairous kai eniautous
verses.literal: You are observing [special] days and months and seasons and years

verses.original: φοβοῦμαι ὑμᾶς μή κεκοπίακα εἰς ὑμᾶς πως εἰκῇ
verses.transliteration: phoboumai hymas mē kekopiaka eis hymas pōs eikē
verses.literal: I fear for you [that] my efforts for you may have been in vain

verses.original: δέομαι ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί Γίνεσθε ὡς ἐγώ ὅτι κἀγὼ ὡς ὑμεῖς ἠδικήσατε με οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: deomai hymōn adelphoi Ginesthe hōs egō hoti kagō hōs hymeis ēdikēsate me ouden
verses.literal: I beg you brothers become like me for I became like you You have done me no wrong . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Οἴδατε ὅτι δι’ ἀσθένειαν τῆς σαρκὸς εὐηγγελισάμην τὸ πρότερον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Oidate hoti di’ astheneian tēs sarkos euēngelisamēn to proteron hymin
verses.literal: - You know that it was because of an illness . . . . . . [that] I first preached the gospel . . . . . . to you

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῇ μου σαρκί τὸν πειρασμὸν ὑμῶν οὐκ ἐξουθενήσατε οὐδὲ ἐξεπτύσατε ἀλλὰ ἐδέξασθέ με ὡς ἄγγελον Θεοῦ ὡς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: kai en tē mou sarki ton peirasmon hymōn ouk exouthenēsate oude exeptysate alla edexasthe me hōs angelon Theou hōs Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: And [although] - my [illness] - [was a] trial to you vvv you did not despise [or] reject [me] Instead you welcomed me as if [I were] an angel of God as if [I were] Christ Jesus [Himself]

verses.original: ποῦ οὖν ὑμῶν ὁ μακαρισμὸς γὰρ μαρτυρῶ ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰ δυνατὸν ἐξορύξαντες ὑμῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐδώκατέ μοι
verses.transliteration: pou oun hymōn ho makarismos gar martyrō hymin hoti ei dynaton exoryxantes hymōn tous ophthalmous edōkate moi
verses.literal: What then [has become] of your - blessing For I can testify - that if [it were] possible you would have torn out your - eyes [and] given [them] to me

verses.original: ὥστε γέγονα ὑμῶν ἐχθρὸς ἀληθεύων ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hōste gegona hymōn echthros alētheuōn hymin
verses.literal: vvv Have I now become your enemy [by] telling you the truth . . .

verses.original: Ζηλοῦσιν ὑμᾶς οὐ καλῶς ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ἐκκλεῖσαι ὑμᾶς ἵνα ζηλοῦτε αὐτοὺς
verses.transliteration: Zēlousin hymas ou kalōs alla thelousin ekkleisai hymas hina zēloute autous
verses.literal: [Those people] are zealous for you . . . [but] not in a good way Instead they want to isolate you [from us] so that you may be zealous for them

verses.original: δὲ καλὸν ζηλοῦσθαι ἐν καλῷ πάντοτε καὶ μὴ μόνον ἐν με τῷ παρεῖναί πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de kalon zēlousthai en kalō pantote kai mē monon en me tō pareinai pros hymas
verses.literal: Nevertheless [it is] good to be zealous if it serves a noble [purpose] at any time and not only when I am - vvv with you

verses.original: μου Τέκνα οὓς πάλιν ὠδίνω μέχρις οὗ Χριστὸς μορφωθῇ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: mou Tekna hous palin ōdinō mechris hou Christos morphōthē en hymin
verses.literal: My children for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until - Christ is formed in you

verses.original: δὲ ἤθελον παρεῖναι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἄρτι καὶ ἀλλάξαι μου τὴν φωνήν ὅτι ἀποροῦμαι ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de ēthelon pareinai pros hymas arti kai allaxai mou tēn phōnēn hoti aporoumai en hymin
verses.literal: [how] I wish I could be with you now and change my - tone because I am perplexed about you

verses.original: Λέγετέ μοι οἱ θέλοντες εἶναι ὑπὸ νόμον οὐκ ἀκούετε τὸν νόμον
verses.transliteration: Legete moi hoi thelontes einai hypo nomon ouk akouete ton nomon
verses.literal: Tell me [you] who want to be under [the] law vvv do you not understand [what] the law [says]

verses.original: γὰρ γέγραπται ὅτι Ἀβραὰμ ἔσχεν δύο υἱοὺς ἕνα ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης καὶ ἕνα ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας
verses.transliteration: gar gegraptai hoti Abraam eschen dyo huious hena ek tēs paidiskēs kai hena ek tēs eleutheras
verses.literal: For it is written that Abraham had two sons one by the slave woman and [the other] by the free [woman]

verses.original: ἀλλ’ μὲν ὁ ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης γεγέννηται κατὰ σάρκα δὲ ὁ ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας δι’ τῆς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: all’ men ho ek tēs paidiskēs gegennētai kata sarka de ho ek tēs eleutheras di’ tēs epangelias
verses.literal: - - His [son] by the slave woman was born according to [the] flesh [but] [his son] by the free [woman] [was born] through the promise

verses.original: ἅτινά ἐστιν ἀλληγορούμενα γάρ αὗται εἰσιν δύο διαθῆκαι μὲν μία ἀπὸ ὄρους Σινᾶ γεννῶσα εἰς δουλείαν ἥτις ἐστὶν Ἁγάρ
verses.transliteration: hatina estin allēgoroumena gar hautai eisin dyo diathēkai men mia apo orous Sina gennōsa eis douleian hētis estin Hagar
verses.literal: These [things] vvv serve as illustrations for [the women] represent two covenants - One [covenant] [is] from Mount Sinai [and bears] children into slavery This is Hagar

verses.original: δὲ τὸ Ἁγὰρ ἐστὶν ὄρος Σινᾶ ἐν τῇ Ἀραβίᾳ δὲ συστοιχεῖ τῇ νῦν Ἰερουσαλήμ γὰρ δουλεύει μετὰ αὐτῆς τῶν τέκνων
verses.transliteration: de to Hagar estin oros Sina en tē Arabia de systoichei tē nyn Ierousalēm gar douleuei meta autēs tōn teknōn
verses.literal: Now - Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in - Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem because she is in slavery with her - children

verses.original: δὲ ἡ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἄνω ἐστίν ἐλευθέρα ἥτις ἐστὶν ἡμῶν μήτηρ
verses.transliteration: de hē Ierousalēm anō estin eleuthera hētis estin hēmōn mētēr
verses.literal: But the Jerusalem above is free [and she] is our mother

verses.original: γάρ γέγραπται Εὐφράνθητι στεῖρα ἡ οὐ τίκτουσα ῥῆξον καὶ βόησον ἡ οὐκ ὠδίνουσα ὅτι πολλὰ μᾶλλον τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐρήμου ἢ τῆς ἐχούσης τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: gar gegraptai Euphranthēti steira hē ou tiktousa rhēxon kai boēson hē ouk ōdinousa hoti polla mallon ta tekna tēs erēmou ē tēs echousēs ton andra
verses.literal: For it is written Rejoice [O] barren woman who vvv bears no children break forth and cry aloud [you] who {have} never travailed because vvv more [are] the children of the desolate woman than of her who has - a husband

verses.original: δέ Ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί κατὰ Ἰσαὰκ ἐστέ τέκνα ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis adelphoi kata Isaak este tekna epangelias
verses.literal: Now you brothers like Isaac are children of promise

verses.original: τότε ἀλλ’ ὁ γεννηθεὶς κατὰ σάρκα ἐδίωκεν τὸν κατὰ Πνεῦμα ὥσπερ οὕτως καὶ νῦν
verses.transliteration: tote all’ ho gennētheis kata sarka ediōken ton kata Pneuma hōsper houtōs kai nyn
verses.literal: At that time however the [son] born by [the] flesh persecuted the [son born] by [the] Spirit vvv [It is] the same . . . now

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τί ἡ γραφή λέγει Ἔκβαλε τὴν παιδίσκην καὶ αὐτῆς τὸν υἱὸν γὰρ ὁ τῆς παιδίσκης υἱὸς οὐ μὴ κληρονομήσει μετὰ τοῦ τῆς ἐλευθέρας υἱοῦ
verses.transliteration: Alla ti hē graphē legei Ekbale tēn paidiskēn kai autēs ton huion gar ho tēs paidiskēs huios ou mē klēronomēsei meta tou tēs eleutheras huiou
verses.literal: But what {does} the Scripture say Expel the slave woman and her - son for the vvv slave woman’s son vvv vvv will never share in the inheritance with the vvv free [woman’s] son

verses.original: διό ἀδελφοί ἐσμὲν οὐκ τέκνα παιδίσκης ἀλλὰ τῆς ἐλευθέρας
verses.transliteration: dio adelphoi esmen ouk tekna paidiskēs alla tēs eleutheras
verses.literal: Therefore brothers we are not children of [the] slave woman but of the free [woman]
